title: Montgomery GI Bill and Chapter 35 - Monthly Rate Paid According to the Confirmed Rate of Pursuit
content:
Under Education Benefits (GI Bill and Dependents' Education), the flat monthly benefit of Chapter 30, Chapter 35 and Chapter 1606 is paid at one of the tier's four flat monthly rates. **The rate paid follows the rate of pursuit confirmed on the student's most recent verification** — the verification entry on the benefit covering the latest month.

**Clause.** A confirmed rate of pursuit of at least 100 percent is paid the full-time rate; at least 75 and below 100 percent the three-quarter-time rate; at least 50 and below 75 percent the half-time rate; above 0 and below 50 percent the less-than-half-time rate, subject to the same tuition limit (never more than the tuition and fees on the resident certification spread over its term at 30 days a month). A benefit with no verification on file, or whose most recent verification confirms 0 percent, is paid at the rate for the training time recorded on the resident term certification.

| Rate of pursuit confirmed on the most recent verification | Rate paid |
|---|---|
| 100 percent | Full-time rate |
| 75 to 99 percent | Three-quarter-time rate |
| 50 to 74 percent | Half-time rate |
| 1 to 49 percent | Less-than-half-time rate, limited by the tuition and fees spread at 30 days a month |
| 0 percent, or no verification on file | Rate for the training time recorded on the resident term certification |

**Boundary pairs (hypothetical confirmations, Chapter 35 rates):** 100 percent is paid $1536.00 and 99 percent $1214.00; 75 percent is paid $1214.00 and 74 percent $804.00; 50 percent is paid $804.00 and 49 percent at most $384.00.

**Case (hypothetical).** A Chapter 30 student certified full time confirms 58 percent on the latest verification: 58 percent is at least 50 and below 75 percent, so the rate paid for the month is the half-time rate of $1259.00.
